settings.label: Logo
settings.info: Shown in place of the name in the header when set.

settings.label: Name
settings.info: Set in the heading face in the header and the footer. Leave empty to use the site name.

settings.label: Phone
settings.info: Printed as typed; the call link drops the spaces.

settings.label: Address
settings.info: One line per line of the address; an empty line starts a second place.

settings.label: Ask label
settings.info: The one call to action: the header button, the menu, the ask panel, and every section button left without a link.

settings.label: Ask link
settings.info: Leave empty to open the ask panel. A link here, such as a scheduler, is followed instead.

settings.label: Form note
settings.info: Printed above every submit button: sending a form does not make someone a client.

settings.label: Legal line
settings.info: Closes every page under the footer: the advertising, registration or responsible-person line your profession asks for, and the copyright. One paragraph per line.
